A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] served as '''steward''' of the [[Temple of Imperfect Repose]] on [[Vaklin]] until [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. She was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Vaklin insurgency]], when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] ordered an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] of the temple.
